_about: PROTOTYPE (overnight run). Remnants' Sheet variants; see .scratch/v1-launch/overnight/TOOLS.md. Ids RA–RC (not A–C: those are shared bodies, TOOLS.md §1).

RA.name: Specimen: the glyph set as stone slices, a type tester, the object-to-stone lineage table, a seed log, the title decrypting live

RB.name: Strata: the title as four frames, a pinned dig down five strata of a chosen glyph with a depth gauge, the Photoshop cut as a parts list, the film with a 60%/100% speed switch

RC.name: Collection: the nine objects in a vitrine row, a catalogue of glyph cards opening one object record, a light table with the ControlNet guide over the stone, the film as glyph chapters

RD.name: Specimen, refined: RA with one lineage picked by key, the ControlNet guide over each seed render, and the film under a caption band that decrypts the title

RE.name: Decipher: three stones as plates, a matching game of the nine glyphs against the nine objects, a before/after wipe from the ControlNet guide to six renders with the first tests struck out, the film with a 60%/100% switch

RF.name: Lexicon: three stones as plates, the nine glyphs as dictionary entries in columns, the picked entry's derivation as a chain with the method on each link, the prompt's variant forms, the film over a 61-second ruler
